sample.paper: “Experiments have been conducted on (111) and (100) oriented n-type Si”
sample.ours: FAMILY: Si_Planar; ORIENTATION: Si111 | Si100; DOPING: n_type (recorded, read by nothing)
sample.note: Dopant, resistivity, growth method (Cz or FZ) not stated.

sample.paper: Figure 7.7: grown at 750 to 1200 °C and “fast pulled”; gas, time, thickness not stated. Figures 7.4 and 7.6: the oxidation is not described
sample.ours: RUN Oxidation … AMBIENT dry_O2, 75 min (ours); 1000 °C for the anneal series
sample.note: The fixed-charge program does not read the time or thickness; the 1983 report's study of charge against thickness (its Figure 10) says thickness matters below about 1000 Å.

sample.paper: “with no low temperature H anneal” (Figures 7.5 and 7.8)
sample.note: Stated for the trap densities; not stated for the fixed charges.
